summary: Iteration 5: tested payment receipts + GST invoice PDF, /api/cron/daily auth/idempotency, renewal reminders, storage alerts (80/95/reset), notifications API and notification bell UI (desktop + 390px mobile), plus regression. New suite tests/test_notifications_cron_invoice.py: 13/14 pass under xdist, 14/14 when run serially. Full suite 90/94; the other 3 failures are environmental (email provider 429 so email_sent=False, and an import job still queued when the 60s wait ran out; all import jobs finished later). UI: badge count, panel, mark-all-read (badge stays hidden after reload), payment notification -> /invoice/<id>, invoice-frame (blob iframe), Download PDF, Plans invoice-pdf-<id> download, invoice-error for an unknown id, storage-alert banner at 84% (amber) and 96% (red), mobile bell with no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390). Admin smoke: all main routes load with no page errors.

minor.issue: Duplicate renewal reminder if two daily jobs overlap. The renewal_reminder_for marker is written only AFTER notify + safe_email, and safe_email can take ~10s when retrying on 429. A second cron run (different X-Webhook-Id) during that window sends the reminder again. Reproduced: 2 'renewal' notifications for one user. Fix: claim the reminder atomically BEFORE notifying, e.g. update_one({user_id, renewal_reminder_for: {$ne: rd}}, {$set: {renewal_reminder_for: rd}}) and only notify if modified_count == 1. Optionally also lock daily_job so only one run happens at a time.

Same read-then-write race: concurrent uploads (several schedule_storage_check tasks) can each read the old prev level and notify twice. Use a conditional update ({user_id, storage_alert_level: prev} -> level) and notify only if modified.
Returns 400 'Invalid body' when the request has no JSON body. Fine if the platform always sends a JSON envelope; otherwise the cron is rejected. Consider making the body optional.

ui_bugs.issue: Popover stays open after clicking a notification item (it navigates, but the panel still covers the page on desktop and mobile). Make the Popover controlled (open state) and close it on item click.

Unknown or forbidden invoice shows the generic 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' instead of 'Invoice not found'. responseType 'blob' turns the error body into a Blob, so errMsg cannot read detail. Parse the error blob as JSON (await e.response.data.text()) or handle 404 explicitly.

issues: The bell sits tight against the KUVANEST wordmark, and the red unread badge overlaps the last letter 'T'. Add a gap or move the bell.
PDF button only shows for status 'paid', but the backend also serves invoices for 'refunded' payments.

The PDF iframe renders blank in headless Chromium, which cannot display PDFs inline. The blob URL is valid and the download works. Please verify manually in a real browser; mobile Safari/Chrome often don't render PDF iframes, so consider a fallback 'Open PDF' link.

action_items: Make renewal reminders idempotent by claiming renewal_reminder_for atomically before notify/email (duplicate reproduced with overlapping cron runs)
Make storage alert level transitions atomic (conditional update) to avoid duplicate alerts from concurrent uploads
Close the notification popover on item click (controlled Popover)
Show the real 404 message on the Invoice page (parse the blob error)
Fix spacing between the bell badge and the logo in the desktop sidebar
critical_code_review_comments: notifications.py renewal_reminders: marker set after slow email causes duplicates; also re-reads settings for every user inside the loop (move it outside)
daily_job runs check_storage_alert one user at a time, each doing its own usage aggregation; this won't scale. Consider one $group aggregate over all users.
NotificationBell onOpen runs read-all and load() at the same time; load can resolve with the pre-read unread count. Not seen in testing, but sequencing them (await read-all, then load) is safer.
usage_bytes counts files in the Recycle Bin (deleted_at set) toward quota and alerts. Probably intentional, but tell users so.
send_receipt only sets receipt_sent_at when the email succeeds, yet nothing retries a receipt that wasn't sent, so a 429 means no receipt email is ever sent (the in-app notification still exists).
seed_data_creation: Throwaway users delivered+kn*@resend.dev (TEST names). UI user delivered+knui1792141962@resend.dev / Passw0rd!23 on the starter plan, payment pay_3e252f1a6a984097. Fake large file docs (file_TESTfake*) and TEST_run_* cron_runs were removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the new suite serially for deterministic results: pytest tests/test_notifications_cron_invoice.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. pytest.ini uses xdist loadscope, so the TestCron and TestRenewal cron triggers can overlap and expose the renewal race. Email 429s are common and make test_resend_pending and the import retry tests flaky. Cron secret is read from /app/backend/.env.
rca of the issue: Duplicate renewal reminder: renewal_reminders reads users where renewal_reminder_for != renewal_date, then awaits notify() and safe_email(). With 429 backoff that takes ~10s, and only then sets renewal_reminder_for. A second daily_job started in that window (another cron id) reads the same unmarked user and notifies again. Repro: set renewal_date to now+2d, POST /api/cron/daily with id A, wait for the notification, POST again with id B within ~5s, and the user has 2 renewal notifications. Mitigation: claim with a conditional update_one before sending.
